Yellow dialogue subtitles appear at the bottom, and a blue banner with the text '東亞探索課' and two small headshots is fixed at the top. (2) The visual cuts to a tight shot of thin beef slices sizzling on a hot metal grill. Sliced white mushrooms and golden garlic chips are arranged around the meat as wisps of steam rise. The lighting is warm and direct on the food. (3) The man returns, gesturing with both hands. A cartoon-style cow icon and the word '和牛' appear next to him as graphic overlays. (4) A still photograph of a single black cow standing in a grassy paddock is shown. White text lists '4 個獨特的牛的品種'. (5) Video footage transitions to a group of black cows in a wooden farm enclosure. The camera captures its mouth and eyes in detail. (7) A portrait of an elderly man in a suit, identified as Lee Teng-hui, is presented. This is followed by a photo of a traditional red-brick courtyard house with a stone plaque that reads '源興居'. (8) The man in the navy shirt continues to speak directly to the camera, using expressive hand movements to emphasize his points until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a crisp 'camera shutter' click SFX followed immediately by a high-tempo, energetic pop BGM featuring a synthesized melody and a punchy electronic drum beat. A male speaker delivers a fast-paced, high-arousal monologue with clear enunciation. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' SFX transition punctuates a visual shift. The BGM remains at a steady 125 BPM, providing a bright and positive harmonic bed for the narration. (3) A digital 'ding' bell SFX triggers. A short snippet of a higher-pitched female voice asks a question, acting as a variety-show-style sound bite before the male speaker continues his energetic delivery. (4) Multiple 'pop' and 'hit' SFX occur rapidly in sync with text appearing on screen. The speaker’s tone remains informative and enthusiastic. (5) Another 'whoosh' and a soft 'thud' SFX mark the transition to historical photographs. The male speaker's pitch variability remains high as he describes the backstory of the cows. (6) The video concludes with a rising electronic stinger and a final 'ding' sound as the BGM fades sharply into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience about the origin and development of 'Yuan Xing Cow,' Taiwan's own Wagyu breed, by detailing its historical lineage from Japan's Tajima cattle and the specific role of former President Lee Teng-hui in this agricultural project.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal narration and rapid-fire editing typical of social media knowledge-sharing content. The juxtaposition of a talking-head format with thematic b-roll (cows, food, history) creates a highly engaging educational flow.
